DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 28, 2026-- Energy Transfer LP (NYSE: ET) today announced an increase in its quarterly cash distribution to $0.3400 per Energy Transfer common unit ($1.36 on an annualized basis) for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.

This cash distribution per Energy Transfer common unit will be paid on August 19, 2026 to unitholders of record as of the close of business on August 7, 2026, and is an increase of more than 3 percent as compared to the second quarter of 2025.

The Partnership also announced a distribution of $0.2111 per Series I Preferred Unit, payable on August 14, 2026.
